sources.title: BLIP-2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tips: BLIP-2 can be used for conditional text generation given an image and an optional text prompt. At inference time, it's recommended to use the generate method. One can use Blip2Processor to prepare images for the model, and decode the predicted tokens ID's back to text. BLIP-2 architecture. Taken from the original paper.

sources.title: arXiv.org e-Print archive
sources.snippet: BLIP introduces a unified vision-language pre-training framework excelling in both understanding and generation-based tasks for improved performance across vision-language applications.

sources.title: blog/blip-2.md at main · huggingface/blog · GitHub
sources.snippet: BLIP-2 is a zero-shot visual-language model that can be used for multiple image-to-text tasks with image and image and text prompts. It is an effective and efficient approach that can be applied to image understanding in numerous scenarios, especially when examples are scarce.
